# Herdr Agent Team

> A delivery team of AI agents for real repositories: staffing, scope, and the
> commit gate are decided by rules instead of by whoever holds the conversation.
> Requires the Herdr desktop app (macOS, Linux, and Windows from
> https://herdr.dev/download/) and, for this harness today, macOS; one command
> installs the skill and its runtime.

Install, then verify:

    npx -y github:tomozard/agent-skills --yes
    hteam check --deep
    hteam

## Start here

- [Human guide](https://tomozard.github.io/agent-skills/): what it is, requirements, install, components, team shapes, model routing, daily use, troubleshooting.
- [Agent install runbook](https://tomozard.github.io/agent-skills/agent-install.html): self-contained steps for an agent acting on a Human's behalf — preflight, install, configure, register projects, hand off.
- [Policy entry point](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/SKILL.md): the four rules, the flow, the gates.
- [Setup phases](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/setup.md): the interactive install/configure conversation, question by question.

## Commands

- `hteam`: start or report the Orchestrator in the Herdr app.
- `hteam check [--deep]`: prerequisites, then installed-artifact integrity.
- `hteam health [--json]`: one readiness verdict for host, Herdr, runtimes, install, routing, vault, and voice; exit 3 when the host cannot run the team.
- `hteam setup [--defaults|--dry-run|--only ...]`: guided setup — host check, folder, vault, project registry, voice.
- `hteam model [--set ROLE TIER RUNTIME MODEL|--unset|--reset|--json]`: pin routing in `~/.config/herdr-team/team.local.json`, re-render, validate.
- `hteam-config show|get|set|validate|path`: per-machine config at `~/.config/herdr-team/hteam.yaml`.
- `hteam-dispatch <role> --brief F --request "…" --risk low`: intake, resolve, spawn in one call.
- `workflow-shape --list`: the eleven task shapes (`W0`–`W10`).
- `task-board create|show|list|event|transition`: the durable task board.
- `roster ROLE TIER`: the runtime and model a role resolves to.
- `runtime-probe`: which agent CLIs exist here and which verbs they support.
- `validate-okf [ROOT]`: validate the OKF contract of Markdown files.

## Components

- [Launcher reference](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/references/launcher.md): `hteam`, config keys, voice engine, failure modes.
- [Team at a glance](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/references/team-at-a-glance.md): authority layers, delivery stages, shapes, Human gates.
- [Workflow shapes](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/references/workflow-shapes.md): intake fields, tiers, escalation, the micro-config lane.
- [Runtime adapters](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/references/runtime-adapters.md): the six verbs and how Pi and Claude are driven.
- [Communication protocol](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/references/communication-protocol.md): messages, verdicts, dispatch accounting.
- [Runtime payload](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/harness/README.md): what the installer puts on the machine.

## Optional

- [Task board and verification gates](https://github.com/tomozard/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/herdr-agent-team/harness/README.md): the frozen-diff SHA-256 contract in detail.
